1: At the North Pole a day before Christmas Eve, Santa's head of security, Callum, senses something strange while patrolling the base.
2: Despite searching the entire base, Santa is nowhere to be found, meaning the most heavily guarded man in the world has been kidnapped.
3: On a winter night filled with Christmas music, a family party is in full swing behind windows framed by twinkling lights.
4: The story goes back decades to a Christmas Eve when a young Jack O'Malley spoiled where all the presents were hidden for his cousins.
5: Jack gulps down a glass of milk and leaves the living room as if to prove that Santa doesn't exist.
6: The boy who didn't believe in Santa grows up to become a hacker who can find anything for money, living a life buried in debt and gambling.
7: Jack walks out of a cafe while taking a call from his creditor Lenny, well past the deadline to pay back his debt.
8: Jack starts a fire in the park to shake off his pursuers and slips into a building during the commotion.
9: Carrying a fire extinguisher inside, Jack passes the card reader and plants a device underneath a desk in the security room.
10: Meanwhile, at a shopping mall, children are telling their wishes to the real Santa, whose codename is Red One and real name is Nicholas, or Nick for short.
11: Standing guard right beside him is the towering Callum Drift, commander of the North Pole security force E.L.F.
12: Santa accepts cookies baked by the children and calls each child waiting in line by name.
13: Beside Santa as he rides down the escalator, Callum tirelessly directs his agents over the radio.
14: As the two head to the airport in a white car, Santa tells Callum that he will miss him when he leaves.
15: After finishing his mall visit, Santa boards his flying sleigh with Callum and returns to the North Pole.
16: In the hangar where giant reindeer await, Callum greets them and hands out treats.
17: Escort fighter jets take off over the snow-covered runway as Santa's sleigh soars into the night sky.
18: At the same time, Jack takes on a suspicious job and tracks down coordinates somewhere on Earth without even knowing what the place is.
19: Santa's sleigh touches down at the North Pole, a massive city hidden beneath the snow.
20: In the workshop where elves and polar bears are hard at work, Santa warmly greets his wife.
21: In the gym later that night, Callum hands his resignation letter to Santa.
22: To deliver billions of presents in a single night, Santa works out every day to stay in shape.
23: Callum explains that the Naughty List grows longer every year and people aren't even afraid of being on it anymore.
24: In the lounge by a crackling fireplace, silence falls between the two men ahead of their final delivery together.
25: That very night, however, a group in camouflage sneaks into the North Pole dome using the coordinates Jack sold.
26: Santa's old log cabin stands in the middle of the base with his sleigh resting quietly beside it.
27: Between a flickering light bulb and an unresponsive agent, Callum finally realizes there has been a breach.
28: He calls out to his agents one by one over the radio, but no one has seen Santa.
29: Callum chases the intruders on a snowmobile, only to find that Santa has already vanished through a hole in the dome.
30: Leaping onto an armored vehicle, Callum races across the snowy terrain in pursuit of the drones and snowmobiles.
31: With only twenty-four hours left until Christmas Eve, Zoe orders agents around the world to launch a joint operation.
32: As director of MORA, a secret agency that oversees mythological beings, Zoe tracks down the hacker who located the North Pole.
33: Jack, known as the "Wolf," wakes up in his bathtub to a call from his ex-wife and goes to pick up his son Dylan.
34: When he learns his son got caught hacking his school attendance records, Jack teaches him hacking tips instead of scolding him.
35: Even when his son mentions his recital that evening, Jack merely wishes him good luck.
36: Returning home, Jack is ambushed by unknown intruders and jumps out a window after a struggle, only to be captured in the end.
37: Jack leaps out the window, but agents are already waiting for him outside the building.
38: When Jack wakes up tied to a chair, Zoe tells him she knows everything he has done.
39: Zoe orders her subordinates to pack Jack into a crate, and he is transported straight to MORA headquarters.
40: Taken to MORA headquarters where the Headless Horseman and other monsters are locked up, Jack hears the unbelievable truth about what happened.
41: Waiting there is Callum, who has rushed over from the North Pole to find Santa and is glaring straight at Jack.
42: Callum is furious the moment he sees Jack, realizing the culprit who put Santa in danger is a Level 4 offender on the Naughty List.
43: Only when the giant polar bear Garcia steps forward does a terrified Jack finally start talking.
44: Fortunately, Jack proves useful because he secretly planted a tracking virus in his client's VPN.
45: Callum straps a tracker onto Jack's wrist and prepares to leave for Aruba.
46: Meanwhile, in a castle dungeon, the winter witch Gryla appears before the imprisoned Santa.
47: Gryla begins draining the magical power from the sleeping Santa.
48: Setting off for Aruba to find Santa, Callum and Jack first stop by a local toy store.
49: Passing through a blue door in the back of the toy store that serves as a portal for North Pole agents, they step right out into Aruba.
50: When Jack asks how Santa visits every house in a single night, Callum replies that they rehearse for 364 days a year.
51: At that same moment in Gryla's castle, an experiment begins to duplicate a mysterious snow globe.
52: The witch's minions use the power siphoned from Santa to mass-produce the snow globes.
53: Callum looks on in disapproval as Jack relaxes with a cocktail under the palm trees.
54: Arriving at a beach resort, Jack uses his keen eye for spotting con artists and playboys to locate the client guarded by mercenaries.
55: After Callum takes out the mercenaries in an instant, the client turns out to be a middleman named Ned.
56: The moment Ned utters her name, the sky darkens and the witch Gryla appears in person.
57: Monstrous snowmen then storm the beach, and although Callum and Jack barely manage to defeat them, Ned is frozen solid.
58: Right after the witch vanishes, giant snowman monsters come marching from across the beach.
59: Hiding behind a bar, Jack uses a flaming grill to melt a snowman's head right off.
60: Meanwhile, in a parking lot, a man opens a ribbon-tied gift box and vanishes in a flash of blue light.
61: However, the man fails to appear in the witch's castle because the duplicated snow globes are still imperfect.
62: Although the trail goes cold, traces of the witch's magic are detected in Germany, where Santa's estranged brother lives.
63: Passing through another toy store to reach Germany, Callum and Jack find the night streets bustling with a Christmas market.
64: During the car ride, Jack gets a call from his ex-wife asking if he is really going to miss his son's recital again.
65: Believing his son doesn't need a father like him, Jack silently stares out the window.
66: Callum tells him the story of Santa's brother, Krampus, explaining that he was the one who originally created the Naughty List.
67: In the middle of a snow-covered cemetery, a tomb door opens, leading down into Krampus's lair.
68: Down in Krampus's lair beneath the cemetery, Jack ignores the warning not to touch anything and reaches into a chest of gold coins.
69: Locked in a cell, Callum confesses to Jack that he has worked for 542 years and was supposed to retire the next day.
70: When the two are finally dragged before Krampus, he reveals that the witch stole the Glaskäfig, a magical snow globe that traps people inside.
71: In the plaza surrounded by horned monsters, the Krampusnacht festival is in full swing.
72: Callum begs him to help rescue his brother, but Krampus coldly refuses, claiming he has retired from the business of punishing people.
73: When Krampus threatens to lock Callum in his lair forever, Jack steps up and bets that if Callum wins a slap match, they both go free.
74: Krampus doesn't even flinch at Callum's slap, and instead knocks Callum off his feet with a single blow of his own.
75: In the second round, Callum grabs his opponent's horn and hurls him away, allowing the two of them to escape the lair in the chaos.
76: As the two get back into the car, the witch is busy choosing her next test subject.
77: On their way back, a self-playing piano appears in the middle of the road holding a gift addressed to Jack right as his son Dylan calls on video.
78: The gift Dylan received is none other than the witch's snow globe, and before Jack can stop him, Dylan vanishes into a flash of light.
79: When Jack and Dylan come to their senses, they find themselves trapped inside glass orbs as part of the witch's collection.
80: The witch mass-produces billions of snow globes and declares that she will deliver them herself tonight.
81: Callum reports the situation to Zoe at MORA headquarters, telling her that Jack and his son have disappeared.
82: Callum suddenly realizes that the North Pole is the only place capable of producing that many snow globes.
83: When Callum video-calls Mrs. Claus, she mentions that she baked macarons, which Santa actually hates.
84: Realizing the witch's shapeshifting sons have taken over the North Pole, Callum and Zoe sneak into the base through an old tunnel.
85: Waiting for them on the snow-covered streets of the North Pole is one of the witch's sons disguised as an E.L.F. agent.
86: Inside his snow globe, Dylan asks his father if he was locked up because he is a bad kid.
87: With tears welling in his eyes, Dylan listens to his father's heartfelt words.
88: The moment Jack sincerely apologizes to his son, the glass orb trapping him shatters into pieces.
89: After breaking free from his glass orb, which had been moved to the North Pole, Jack reunites with Callum and his team.
90: With Santa's sleigh already prepped for departure, Callum charges into the hangar alongside the polar bear Garcia.
91: Clinging to the speeding sleigh, Callum and Jack barely manage to bring it to a halt, only for the witch to transform into a giant monster and block their path.
92: Just then, Krampus leaps down from the sky, unable to turn his back on his brother despite his earlier refusal.
93: Right as Callum is about to fall to the witch's tentacles, Santa awakens from his slumber and shouts a magical command.
94: Restored to full strength by Santa's command, Krampus holds out a glass orb that sucks the witch Gryla inside and traps her for good.
95: After saving his brother, Krampus departs, and the North Pole base bustles with activity once again.
96: Running six minutes behind schedule, the elves hurry to prepare the sleigh while Santa decides to bring Jack and Dylan along for the ride.
97: Watching Santa travel around the entire world in a single night, Jack finally comes to believe in him.
98: Santa darts down chimneys to fill stockings and flies across rooftops with a rocket-powered toy sack on his back.
99: Through it all, Callum is finally able to see once again that there is still a child inside the hearts of even the naughtiest adults.
100: This was director Jake Kasdan's *Red One*, a Christmas action film starring Dwayne Johnson and Chris Evans on a mission to rescue Santa.
